overview: The Command Spire directs Akhevan military operations, patrol coordination, and strategic enforcement of Praesertum decrees.
history: Constructed as the first military structure during Ka Vethan’s founding.
Void‑arcane communication conduits were added to coordinate distant patrols.
Tactical resonance arrays enhanced command efficiency during early conflicts.
Praesertum decrees formalized the Spire’s authority over all military orders.
Modern Spire remains the highest seat of Akhevan strategic command.
hooks: A tactical resonance array destabilizes mid‑operation.
A Praesertum directive requires immediate enforcement.
A patrol returns with anomalous void‑arcane readings.
A command chamber experiences communication interference.
